description: Block edits on sensitive files (.env, secrets, credentials)

PreToolUse.command: FILEPATH=$(echo '$TOOL_INPUT' | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if echo "$FILEPATH" | grep -qE '(\.env|\.env\.|credentials|secrets|private.*key|id_rsa)'; then echo "BLOCKED: Cannot edit sensitive file: $FILEPATH" && exit 1; fi; exit 0

FILEPATH=$(echo '$TOOL_INPUT' | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); if echo "$FILEPATH" | grep -qE '(\.env|\.env\.|credentials|secrets|private.*key|id_rsa)'; then echo "BLOCKED: Cannot write sensitive file: $FILEPATH" && exit 1; fi; exit 0

usage: Copy this template to .claude/settings.json. Adjust the regex pattern to match your project's sensitive files.
